ns2:course.label: Small Business Consulting
ns2:course.description: (B ADM 345) Through guided experience, students identify and offer advice to local small business firms; exposes students, serving as consultants, to the wide variety of problems facing the smaller firm as well as enables them to apply current business methods to real problems. Students work in teams. Prerequisite: Junior standing in the College of Business or admission to the Master of Business Administration program; or consent of instructor.
